changes.title: Google search landscape: metro areas and rank by website type added
changes.summary: 425 of the 2,240 searches name one of 58 metro areas: who holds their top 10, by metro size and for each metro with enough searches, with the web addresses of all 1,968 websites in those results read one by one. A new table gives the average rank and rank spread of each type of website.
